means cause or persuade someone to do something.

“resulted in something.” 
Correction: 
• 
to postponing → should be to postpone 
•

buyers” refers to multiple people. 
Correct sentence: 
The spike in housing prices has led many first-time buyers to 
postpone their plans indefinitely.

(a) to postpone their plan indefinitely → “plan” should be 
plural (plans) since it refers to many buyers. 
•

form should be to postpone, not past tense.

preposition (“in”) and wrong adjective form (“indefinite” 
should be “indefinitely”).
